description: This file defines the 'Flat' shipping method class within the OpenCart system, extending the core model engine. It includes methods for obtaining shipping quotes based on geographic zone configurations, and interacts with various system configurations, language, and currency modules.

classes.name: Flat
classes.description: Represents a flat rate shipping method that calculates quotes based on configured geo zones and costs within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns shipping quote details based on the provided address, considering geo zone restrictions and costs.
